potential.baseline: train-fold prevalence constant probability, clipping only numerical logloss safety at 1e-15
potential.family: sklearn LogisticRegression L2 C=1 solver=liblinear max_iter=1000 tol=0.0001 random_state=570928; train-only median+missing indicator and StandardScaler; no search/calibration refit
potential.featureSource: one uniquely identified frozen causal pre-entry feature vector shared across IM and R1; verify every knownAt<=Entry; if multiple plausible sources cannot be resolved without results, POTENTIAL_FEATURE_SCHEMA_AMBIGUOUS and fits 0
potential.fitBudget: 2 heads * F outer fits max, F=4, only folds with legal train and nonempty score; earlier Development train and frozen 24-session score; no Entry train/test duplicate
potential.role: OOF_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY; no HOLD veto/SELL/Guard override/Capital sizing/ranking
potential.skill: per-head clustered bootstrap ROC-AUC lower95 strictly >0.5, OOF Brier and log loss both strictly below train-prevalence baseline, IM and R1 point AUC >=0.5 when estimable, reproducible OOF; PR-AUC/reliability/per-session diagnostics

power.method: conditional fixed-layout parametric session-cluster simulation: scores=delta*y+standard_normal_entry+0.25*standard_normal_session, delta=sqrt(2)*NormalPPF(0.60); 1000 independent repetitions, 199 session-bootstrap resamples each; empirical 2.5th percentile ROC-AUC strictly >0.5 declares detection; simulate only label/session geometry, no actual features; if fewer than 95 percent bootstrap draws valid, no-go
power.powerOneSidedGate: power fraction >=0.80; all count/session conditions also required; no feature fit before gate
